requirements.behavior: verdict() returns INCONCLUSIVE when checks array is empty or any check status is not 'passed'; returns PASSED only when all checks have status 'passed'
validate() throws when the image field does not match sha256:<64 hex chars>
requirements.basis: src/audit.mjs — validate(): `if(!/^sha256:[a-f0-9]{64}$/.test(spec?.image||''))throw Error('Immutable local image ID required');`

requirements.behavior: validate() requires 1-10 checks with unique names, valid argv (non-empty string array without null bytes), and integer timeout between 100 and 120000 ms
requirements.basis: src/audit.mjs — validate(): checks length, name regex, duplicate names, argv validation, timeout range

requirements.behavior: repositoryURL() accepts valid HTTPS GitHub repository URLs and returns the .git URL
requirements.basis: src/repository.mjs — repositoryURL(): validates protocol https:, hostname github.com, no port/user/pass/search/hash

requirements.behavior: repositoryURL() rejects HTTP, embedded credentials, non-GitHub hosts, file URLs, branch paths, and query strings
requirements.basis: src/repository.mjs — repositoryURL(): protocol, hostname, path, and traversal validation

requirements.behavior: resolveRevision() returns the full 40-char SHA of the HEAD commit
inspectProject() reads committed README content from the given SHA, ignoring uncommitted working-tree changes
requirements.basis: src/project.mjs — inspectProject(): uses `git show ${sha}:${path}` to read committed content

requirements.behavior: Bridge returns 401 Unauthorized when the Authorization header does not match the expected Bearer token
requirements.basis: src/bridge.mjs — timingSafeEqual comparison of Bearer token

requirements.behavior: Bridge returns 200 with {projects:[...]} on GET /projects with valid auth
Bridge returns 409 when a second job is submitted while another audit is already running
requirements.basis: src/bridge.mjs — `if(busy)return send(res,409,{error:'An audit is already running'})`

requirements.behavior: Bridge returns 400 for invalid project names (path traversal), invalid revision format, or unknown keys in the request body
requirements.basis: src/bridge.mjs — body validation: checks for allowed keys, project existence, revision format ^[a-f0-9]{40,64}$

requirements.behavior: Bridge returns 403 when the Origin header is present (browser cross-origin clients not supported)
requirements.basis: src/bridge.mjs — `if(req.headers.origin)return send(res,403,{error:'Browser origins are not supported'})`
